title: Real Ventures 2026 Annual Meeting (Montreal) — Eric Ries keynote on Incorruptible; 'every attendee went home with their own copy of this #mustreadbook'
summary: Real Ventures — Montreal-based VC firm (21K followers) — hosts its 2026 Annual Meeting around the theme #DefyingGravity, with Eric as the keynote walking attendees through the novel ideas behind Incorruptible. Every LP, founder, investor, and community member in the room went home with a copy of the book. Host: Aithan Shapira. Corporate account post: 25 likes.
blockquote: To Eric Ries, thank you for joining us as our keynote and walking us through the novel ideas behind your new book, #Incorruptible. Eric made visible the forces that quietly pull mission-driven companies away from their purpose as they scale, and provides concrete ways for founders to safeguard their mission as they grow. The room was captivated, and every attendee went home with their own copy of this #mustreadbook. We can't wait to see what his ideas spark in our community.

source_urls.label: Annelie Justiniano De Moya (Vice Consul, Dominican Republic ↔ Quebec) attendee reaction — 'Can't wait to dive into it!'
